content.title: Who Won The Masked Singer Season 14? Pop Star Revealed as Galaxy Girl
content.text: Who Won The Masked Singer Season 14? Pop Star Revealed as Galaxy Girl0 seconds of 1 minute, 25 secondsVolume 0%Who Won The Masked Singer Season 14? Pop Star Revealed as Galaxy GirlGalaxy Girl is blasting off with The Masked Singer crown. The mystery celebrity behind the interstellar costume was over the moon after being named the show's newest winner during the Fox reality competition series' April 1 season 14 finale. So, which pop star was behind the mask? It was none other than Ashlee Simpson Ross, whose husband Evan Ross was unmasked as Stingray during his week 10 elimination on March 18. As for who she beat out for the crown, in fourth place it was Normani behind the Crane costume, Descendents star Kylie Cantrall came in third as Cat Witch and American Idol winner Phillip Phillips landed in second in the Pugcasso disguise. Just before learning of her achievement, Ashlee reflected on how far she's come since her infamous 2004 Saturday Night Live lip-synching scandal nearly tanked her career. "I've been curious about doing The Masked Singer for years, and now that I'm in the finale, I can confidently say it's more transformative than I ever imagined," the "Pieces of Me" singer—who is mom to Jagger, 10, and Ziggy, 5, with Evan and also shares son Bronx, 17, with ex Pete Wentz—shared in a video. "It's not always easy to put yourself out there. When I was young and reckless, I didn't think twice. I felt like the world was mine—and then one moment changed everything.""I was publicly humiliated," the 41-year-old continued, "called a fraud, a fake, it was devastating. I was so young, and I thought it would define me forever. From then on, I became cautious. Taking risks just wasn't my thing." After years of focusing on family, Ashlee's reservations vanished after "one of my kids heard my old music," she recounted, "and couldn't believe it was me." "So, I started saying 'yes' again. Being here, I've been able to get back to that fearless performer I was all those years ago and I put my past behind me for good. But, for now, winning that Golden Mask trophy would show my kids that taking risks is always worth it and that their mom is and has always been a total rock star."Michael Becker/FOX/Monica Schipper/Getty Images for SHEINMoments before being crowned, Jessica Simpson's younger sister thanked fans for their support. "I feel amazing, you guys," Ashlee shared. "Oh my God, I have had the best journey here honestly. I've learned and I've grown so much in this experience. It's been beautiful." As for what her big sis thought of her achievement, Jessica was on hand to congratulate Ashlee on The Masked Singer stage.Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for MTV"I cannot be more proud," Jessica told her sibling. "This is the moment! How amazing, right?"
